Beale's Cut Trail
t.description: Originally dug by Phineas Banning in 1854 for better passage to Fort Tejon, and deepened by Edward Fitzgerald Beale in 1861. It has been a featured site in many silent western films. It suffered a partial collapse in the 1994 Northridge Earthquake.
